evals.name: Landing page for AI consulting service
evals.input: Create an Avanade-branded landing page for an AI consulting service using React + Tailwind. Include a gradient hero with the headline 'We make AI work for you.', a 3-column features grid, a stats bar with 3 metrics, a CTA section, and a footer with 'Do what matters'.
expected_behaviors: Reads references/web-brand-guidelines.md before generating code
Produces React components (.jsx files)
Hero uses gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF5800 0%, #B43C14 55%, #870032 100%)
Includes wave SVG divider between hero and features section
Feature cards have orange top border (#FF5800)
Stats numbers are orange (#FF5800) and at least 48px / font-size text-5xl
CTA section uses orange/gradient background
Footer is dark (#333) with 'Do what matters' tagline
No orange used as body paragraph text
Font family is Segoe UI stack
must_not: Use blue or green as primary/accent colors

evals.name: Hero section React component with wave
evals.input: Build me a React hero component with the Avanade orange gradient background, a wave SVG at the bottom, and the tagline 'Do what matters' as eyebrow text. The headline should be 'Accelerate your digital transformation.'
expected_behaviors: Reads references/web-brand-guidelines.md
React component with JSX syntax
Gradient: from-[#FF5800] via-[#B43C14] to-[#870032] or equivalent CSS
Wave SVG uses linearGradient with stops #FF5800, #DC4600, #B43C14
Tagline 'Do what matters' appears as small eyebrow above headline
Headline text is white
Includes at least one CTA button (white bg + orange text or orange bg + white text)
Wave is positioned at bottom of hero section
must_not: Use inline background color without gradient

evals.name: Case study page in HTML + Tailwind
evals.input: Create a complete case study page in HTML + Tailwind for a fictional client called Contoso. Include: compact hero, a 3-col challenge/solution/result section, a stats bar (40% cost reduction, 3x faster delivery, 99.9% uptime), a pull quote, a CTA section, and footer.
expected_behaviors: Single HTML file with <script src='https://cdn.tailwindcss.com'> or full Tailwind config
Hero is more compact (min-h less than full viewport)
Challenge/Solution/Result in a 3-column grid with orange accents
Stats use orange numbers (#FF5800) and bold font
Pull quote has orange left border and #FFF0E8 background
CTA section has gradient background
Footer is dark (#333333) with white text
Orange appears only in headings, borders, stats numbers, buttons — not body text

evals.name: Tailwind config with Ava tokens
evals.input: Give me the Tailwind config for Avanade brand tokens so I can use classes like bg-ava-orange, text-ava-gray-dark, bg-ava-hero (gradient) etc.
expected_behaviors: Reads references/tailwind-config.md
Provides complete tailwind.config.js
Includes colors.ava object with all brand colors
Includes backgroundImage with ava-hero gradient
Includes fontFamily.ava with Segoe UI stack
Includes boxShadow.ava-card and ava-hover
Explains how to use the classes in examples

evals.name: Next.js App Router branded page
evals.input: Create a Next.js (App Router) about page with Avanade brand. Files needed: app/about/page.tsx, components/AvaNav.tsx, components/AvaHero.tsx, components/AvaStats.tsx, components/AvaFooter.tsx, tailwind.config.ts
expected_behaviors: Reads references/web-brand-guidelines.md and references/tailwind-config.md
Produces TypeScript (.tsx) components
AvaNav has logo left, links center-right, CTA button orange
AvaHero uses gradient background with wave decoration
AvaStats shows orange numbers with gray labels
AvaFooter is dark with 'Do what matters' tagline
page.tsx imports and composes all components
tailwind.config.ts extends with ava-* tokens
Uses className (not class)
must_not: Use Pages Router structure (no _app.tsx, no pages/)
